defectsClosed.title: execute performed no boundary preflight
defectsClosed.detail: The runner read the manifest and began the acquisition loop immediately. A workflow flag is not a runtime observation.
defectsClosed.correction: runRuntimeDiscovery runs inside the container before the first acquisition call, using the same implementation discovery uses; failure halts with EXECUTE_BOUNDARY_PREFLIGHT_FAILED and every call count is reported as zero

defectsClosed.title: post-acquisition verification checked only size
defectsClosed.detail: du -sb against a 100 MB threshold, with no item sets, file sets, digests, commit state, staging check or verdict. The raw artifact was then uploaded with if: always(), including after a partial run.
defectsClosed.correction: verifyRawEvidence performs actor-2 verification; the volume rule runs after it; verified evidence and incomplete forensic output are separate artifacts; the uploaded artifact digest is recorded and re-verified by a separate download job; Job C runs the identity-leak scan

defectsClosed.title: the determinism decision compared only pass fingerprints
defectsClosed.detail: A nondeterministic downstream ordering changes candidates or selection while the pass fingerprints stay equal, and the runner labelled that timing-only. SEMANTIC_DIFFERENCE also returned exit 1, which skipped the following verification step for a valid preregistered outcome.
defectsClosed.correction: nine preregistered levels compared, timing confinement checked rather than assumed, and COMPLETE_WITH_NONDETERMINISM treated as a successful acquisition outcome

defectsClosed.title: the run-level writer trusted caller assertions
defectsClosed.detail: Item outcome and aggregateSha256 came from the runner; the determinism object was open and was spread after runId and itemCount, so caller fields could overwrite them. The manifest did not cover counts.json or determinism-report.json, and the per-file commit left an ambiguous partial state.
defectsClosed.correction: every item fact derived from the committed files; a closed determinism schema with the writer's facts written last; the manifest covers the run-level files; and RUN_COMMITTED.json is an exclusive final marker binding every run-level digest

defectsClosed.title: the execute gate cannot authenticate its own continued existence
defectsClosed.detail: The workflow and the gate script are both loaded from the current branch head, so a transition commit that modifies the workflow could bypass the gate before it rejects that modification.
defectsClosed.correction: the gate is stated as defense in depth, not self-authenticating authorization, and the frozen procedure requires an externally reviewed transition commit identified by full SHA before it is pushed
